explanation: A type II region has the form c ≤ y ≤ d, g₁(y) ≤ x ≤ g₂(y), so each horizontal slice is a single interval. Option c satisfies this: every horizontal line between y = 0 and y = 1 intersects the region in one interval bounded by the two curves. Each other pictured region has horizontal slices split into two intervals.
